preparedData.knownWalkCheck: Independently verify SHA/byte counts of all read files, match each entire prior eligible sampled 3D walk to a unique directed continuation from its identical original source start in one complete new section graph. Verify access, original area/distance/gain/repetition/road criteria, simple loop or lollipop structure, and remeasure haversine distance and complete elevation profile. No preparation helpers or solver imports. This demonstrates known-walk retention, not search discovery completeness.

independentVerification.method: Independent source-walk verifier reads retained directed steps against the pinned graph. Checks legal start/access, directed continuity, one simple circuit with optional identical reversible stem, exact traversal-order metrics and all strict submitted limits. Does not import the production solver, grouping, metric helpers or route store.

groupingObservation.case: Two displayed Cabin-SST Spur / Cabin representatives in the small slice overlap by 95.28%, but belong to separate aggregate families. Adding the later representative to the earlier family would reduce its common/combined trail footprint to 84.04%.
groupingObservation.implication: The approved aggregate rule prevents gradual drift but can still display similar representatives. A family-first replacement may need a revised stable structural definition; do not silently change this UX rule.

diagnosis.conclusion: Repeated approach enumeration is a concrete dominant cost. Raw minor circuit variants are grouped only after exhaustive circuit/approach enumeration. This does not prove practical distinct-hike discovery impossible; it invalidates the current runtime expectation.
